method: Deterministic replay of the unchanged first-run homepage prompt; not a model rerun
instructorProvidedFacts: record-1: Fictional seed-club register: Cedar Exchange had twenty-eight registered members throughout April. The register did not change, and both April workshops admitted only these registered members.

record-2: The sowing workshop recorded nineteen distinct members. The storage workshop recorded seventeen distinct members. Each attendance list counted a member once, regardless of how long they stayed.
record-3: The two attendance lists have not been matched to identify members attending both. Visiting members of other clubs were not admitted to either workshop.
objectives: Use a fixed population and two deduplicated attendance counts to justify feasible attendance bounds with concrete allocations.
